visual_features: Thin, dark, elongated hair-like fiber on a light substrate.
outcome: Acquired spectrum of a hair-like object; signal dominated by fluorescence, making definitive chemical identification difficult from a single shot.
metrics: Max intensity ~5100 ADU, Background ~1700 ADU, high fluorescence baseline.
lesson: Organic fibers (like hair or synthetic textiles) exhibit strong fluorescence at 532nm excitation, which can mask Raman peaks. Simple background subtraction may leave a residual slope; iterative polynomial subtraction is better but SNR remains low for single-shot measurements.
